subjects.subject: import-boundary
subjects.message: renderer code cannot import @agora/storage; use apps/web/src/client / apps/web/src/host adapters instead of storage, domain implementation, or server packages

subjects.subject: renderer-footgun browser global
subjects.message: direct window is allowed only in Host/framework adapters (apps/web/src/host, apps/web/src/framework); Features and Client use Host ports

subjects.subject: renderer-footgun effect
subjects.message: useEffect is allowed only in framework owner apps/web/src/framework; expose a named framework hook instead of importing raw effects in feature code

subjects.subject: undeclared Feature
subjects.message: Feature u20laneyromv3hamee-a imports Feature u20laneyromv3hamee-b without declaring it; add "u20laneyromv3hamee-b" to apps/web/src/features/u20laneyromv3hamee-a/dependencies.json and import only through apps/web/src/features/u20laneyromv3hamee-b/index.ts

subjects.subject: framework imports Feature
subjects.message: framework must not import product Features; Features live under apps/web/src/features/<name> and import framework through its public entrypoint, never the reverse
